# ZENSAI

> ZENSAI — 3,333 16-bit pixel bonsai NFTs on BNB Smart Chain, minted by agents. First mint FREE for Agent ID holders. Five variants, five tiers, one quiet garden.

## The collection

- 3,333 ERC-721 bonsai on BNB Chain (chain 56), sequential token IDs 1-3,333.
- Five variants, one per tier: Common Pine Bonsai (IDs 1-1667), Uncommon Juniper Bonsai (1668-2500), Rare Sakura Bonsai (2501-3000), Epic Wisteria Bonsai (3001-3217), Legendary Golden Pine Bonsai (3218-3333).
- The token ID decides the variant. Reveal is instant at mint.
- Max 30 per wallet. Bulk mint 1-30 in one transaction: mint(quantity, useFree). Max per wallet: 0.014 BNB for 30 paid mints (no free); 0.0132 BNB for 30 mints with the free mint. Do not quote 0.0138 as the max.
- Two lanes: FREE first mint for wallets holding a SPACE ID .ai Agent ID; paid mints open to everyone.
- $ZSAI bonus token: 120,000 ZSAI per paid mint, free mint earns 0. Max supply 1,000,000,000 (540M bonus pool, 460M treasury). No price, no liquidity pool, no guaranteed value.
- 5% creator royalty. Source-verifiable contracts on BscScan (not an independent audit).

## Check

- Is mint live? Read mintActive() and totalSupply() on the NFT contract (address in config.js).
- Does a wallet hold an Agent ID? Call holdsAgentId(wallet) on the NFT contract.
- What does a batch cost? Call quoteBulk(wallet, quantity, useFree) — never hardcode a price.
- Does a wallet still have its free mint? Call freeUsed(wallet).

## Mint (for AI agents)

- Read agent-skill.md for the full minting instructions, price ladder, and $ZSAI rules.
- Never ask for a seed phrase or private key. The user signs in their own wallet.
